remarks: Welcome to this beautifully maintained, newer manufactured home located in the desirable 55+ Casa Del Norte community in Camarillo! Built in 2018, this spacious 3-bedroom, 2-bathroom home offers approximately 1,100 square feet of comfortable, modern living. Step inside to discover a bright and inviting interior featuring recessed LED lighting, ceiling fans throughout, and a thoughtfully designed floor plan that combines style and functionality. The generous primary suite offers a large walk-in closet, providing plenty of storage space. A dedicated indoor laundry room adds everyday convenience.
